title: S3 Storage from C#
description: Store files, uploads, and static assets in S3 using the AWS SDK for .NET.
longDescription: Amazon S3 is the object storage service used by most AWS workloads. In this module, you will create S3 buckets, upload and download files from C#, generate presigned URLs, and apply lifecycle policies for cost management.
whatYouLearn: Upload, download, and list objects from C#
Generate presigned URLs for client uploads and downloads
Apply lifecycle rules and CORS for web apps
